reason: The context-switching pain is real — I run three AI agents a day and re-explaining context kills me — but I'm not handing my code and session data to a vendor I've never heard of on a launch day. The local daemon helps, but there's no track record, no audit, and no one I trust vouching for it yet. $30/seat is cheap enough; trust isn't.
objection: I don't trust a new vendor with my code and session data — unknown security, no audit, no reputation, and my code is the company.
would_change_my_mind: A third-party security audit plus public source/self-host option, or an engineering lead I already trust vouching for it.
